title: The Day the Goats Appeared
skyStory: Last quarter, sixty-two percent, and the moon is still in Capricorn, the sea-goat, making a final circuit of the summit before it leaves. Capricorn likes to say goodbye with a gift. Tonight the gift is goats. Many goats. In pictures, on signs, in conversation. Saturn denies arranging this. The goat is smirking.

reading: Goats will be everywhere today. A goat on a cheese label, a goat on a coffee mug, someone saying I am such a goat about something. Count them. By 3 pm, you will hit seven.

Seven is the magic number today, because Nancy, born under the sea-goat, will have counted exactly seven too. Don't even scream. The Capricorn moon is waving goodbye with both hooves. When you compare notes, the Tiger will be pleased. Sometimes the universe just wants to remind you that the mountain is never far. The [[Wheel of Fortune]] turns, and it lands on the same spot twice.
joel.mission: Count every goat you see or hear about today, in any form, and report the total at dusk.
joel.omen: A real live goat or a picture of one before 9 am. It means the count is on, so pay attention.

reading: The sea-goat moon is leaving your sign tonight, and it wants to give you something before it goes. You will notice goats today, in places goats should not be, on signs, in books, in a stranger's joke.

Count them. The Wood Rat counts everything anyway. You will reach seven by late afternoon. Then text Joel, and he will have exactly seven too. ΔΕΣ. Capricorn and Aries, mountain and fire, counting goats in perfect sync. Tell the story at dinner with both hands making little horns. Everyone at the table will look at you like you have lost the plot, and that is perfect.
nancy.mission: Count goats all day and make little horns with your fingers each time you spot one.
nancy.omen: A goat on a sign or label you have walked past a hundred times. It means the universe is in on the joke.

together.text: DES day. Count goats all day, any kind: drawn, spoken, carved, real. Compare totals at sunset. If they match, the sea-goat leaves Capricorn with a satisfied bleat. If they do not, recount, because it is probably seven.

game.intro: Goats appeared out of nowhere. DES! Choose your goat-adjacent fate and guess your friend's.
game.question: A goat moves in with you for a week. What is its job?
